name: Google Gemini
hint: The easiest key is a free one from Google AI Studio (starts with AIza). Vertex AI express keys (AQ.…) work too once the API is enabled for their project.

name: Groq (fast, free tier)
hint: Free key from the Groq console (starts with gsk_). Very fast. Recommended model: openai/gpt-oss-120b (works well with the CraftAI editing tools). "Load models" shows the ones your key can use.

name: Ollama (local, free)
hint: Runs on this PC, no key and no internet. Install Ollama and pull a model first.

name: OpenAI
hint: Key from platform.openai.com. Recommended model: gpt-4o-mini or better.

name: OpenRouter
hint: One key for many models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta…). Model ids look like "openai/gpt-4o-mini".

name: xAI Grok
hint: Key from console.x.ai. Grok speaks the OpenAI chat API; "Load models" lists the models your key can use.

name: Mistral
hint: Key from console.mistral.ai. Model ids look like mistral-small-latest; "Load models" lists the ones your key can use.

name: DeepSeek
hint: Key from platform.deepseek.com. Model ids: deepseek-chat (fast) or deepseek-reasoner.

name: Custom (OpenAI-compatible)
hint: Any service that speaks the OpenAI chat API: set its address (base URL) and the exact model id below. LM Studio and similar local servers work too — the key may be any value the server accepts.

name: Codex (native)
hint: Uses your existing Codex sign-in. No API key, Node or npm needed; the native engine can be downloaded here.

name: Claude (native)
hint: Uses your existing Claude sign-in. No API key, Node or npm needed; the native engine can be downloaded here.

name: OpenCode (native)
hint: Uses the providers you connected in OpenCode (opencode auth login), including its free models. No API key, Node or npm needed; the native engine can be downloaded here. Model ids are provider/model, e.g. opencode/claude-fable-5-2.
